contextual_text: Sub-Categories of Drones Beyond design, drones are further classified based on their operational capabilities and the level of human control involved. Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) – The most common type of drone, actively controlled by a human pilot through a remote controller or ground station. This category includes consumer drones, commercial drones, and industrial RPAS used for applications like aerial photography, surveillance, and mapping. Model RPAS – Specifically designed for research, education, and hobbyist use, these drones do not require commercial approvals but must adhere to safety and operational guidelines. Autonomous Drones – Operate without direct human intervention, relying on pre-programmed flight paths and AI- driven navigation. These drones require special permissions from DGCA due to their potential impact on airspace management and safety. 10
